title: Fields of The World: Field Boundaries for Croatia
description: Field boundaries representing agricultural land parcels in Croatia, vectorized from orthophoto imagery and classified by land use type. Data originates from the ARKOD registry maintained by the Croatian Agency for Payments, with field boundaries valid for 2023.

_readme.text:
## Description

This dataset is adapted from the data published by Republic of Croatia, in the ARKOD system. ARKOD is a record of the use of agricultural land in the territory of the Republic of Croatia, which is maintained in digital graphic form by the Agency for Payments.

ARKOD plots represent uninterrupted areas of agricultural land cultivated by one farmer, classified according to the type of use of agricultural land from gievn Annex I of the Ordinance on records of use of agricultural land.

Process for registration of agricultural land - vectorization of ARKOD polygons is carried out by the method of photointerpretation of agricultural land on DOF bases on a scale of 1:5000 in branches of the Agency for Payments, statements of farmers on the use of agricultural land with proof of ownership or possession.

_The field boundaries are valid for the year 2023_

- **Original Data Provider:** [The Agency for Payments in Agriculture, Fisheries and Rural Development](https://www.apprrr.hr/prostorni-podaci-servisi/)
- **Converted by:** Kerner Lab (ASU)
- **License:** Open Data
- **Projection:** EPSG:4326
